cases.title: Landing page loads for an anonymous visitor
cases.expected: Public landing page renders without authentication
cases.actual: Landing page served, title 'Lodestone - Student Wellbeing, Before Silence Becomes Crisis - Lodestone'.

cases.title: Anonymous request for the student dashboard
cases.expected: Redirect to sign-in instead of serving private data
cases.actual: Redirected to the sign-in page with a ReturnUrl.

cases.title: Anonymous request for the counselor queue
cases.expected: Redirect to sign-in
cases.actual: Counselor workspace is not reachable while signed out.

cases.title: Registration with every field empty
cases.expected: Required-field validation messages, no account created
cases.actual: Required-field messages shown; the form did not submit.

cases.title: Registration with mismatched password confirmation
cases.expected: 'The passwords do not match.' and no account created
cases.actual: Password mismatch reported; registration refused.

cases.title: Registration with a password below the minimum length
cases.expected: Length validation message at 4 characters against a minimum of 8
cases.actual: Minimum password length enforced.

cases.title: Registration with an illegal student number
cases.expected: Format message; the claim is refused
cases.actual: Student-number format rule reported.

cases.title: Registration without accepting the privacy commitment
cases.expected: Consent message; no account created
cases.actual: Consent rule enforced; registration refused.

cases.title: Registration with valid details and consent accepted
cases.expected: Account is created and the student is signed in
cases.actual: Account created and signed in; landed on https://localhost:5001/Student.

cases.title: Registration reusing an existing email address
cases.expected: Duplicate is refused with a readable message
cases.actual: Duplicate email refused with a message.

cases.title: Sign in with the wrong password
cases.expected: Refusal with a non-specific message
cases.actual: Sign-in refused without disclosing which field was wrong.

cases.title: Sign in with an email that has no account
cases.expected: Same refusal as a wrong password (no account enumeration)
cases.actual: Unknown account refused with the same message as a wrong password.

cases.title: Sign in with valid credentials
cases.expected: Session established and role redirect applied
cases.actual: Signed in and redirected to https://localhost:5001/Student.

cases.title: Open the private mood journal
cases.expected: Journal page renders with the entry form
cases.actual: Journal page rendered for the signed-in student.

cases.title: Record today's mood entry
cases.expected: Entry is stored and shown in the history
cases.actual: Entry submitted; the journal accepted today's check-in.

cases.title: Record a second mood entry on the same day
cases.expected: One entry per UTC day; the second is refused
cases.actual: The entry form is withdrawn for the rest of the day, with a message.

cases.title: Open the peer forum
cases.expected: Category list renders
cases.actual: Forum categories listed.

cases.title: Publish a discussion with an empty title and body
cases.expected: Validation messages; nothing is published
cases.actual: Empty title and body refused.

cases.title: Publish a valid discussion
cases.expected: Post is stored and its detail page opens
cases.actual: Discussion published at https://localhost:5001/Forum/Post/4.

cases.title: Reply to a discussion
cases.expected: Comment is stored and displayed
cases.actual: Reply stored and rendered on the discussion.

cases.title: Report a discussion without giving a reason
cases.expected: Guidance message; no flag recorded
cases.actual: The empty report was blocked and the page did not submit.

cases.title: Type past the reply length limit
cases.expected: The reply box stops at the same 2,000 characters the server accepts
cases.actual: The reply box stops at 2000 characters, matching the server limit.

cases.title: Type past the report reason length limit
cases.expected: The report box stops at the same 500 characters the server accepts
cases.actual: The report box stops at 500 characters, matching the server limit.

cases.title: Open a discussion that does not exist
cases.expected: Not-found page rather than a server error
cases.actual: A discussion identifier that does not resolve returns a not-found page.

cases.title: Search the crisis resources with a sentence
cases.expected: Ranked resources are listed
cases.actual: Search returned a ranked result page.

cases.title: Search the crisis resources with a 3,000 character query
cases.expected: Query is truncated to the ranking limit; page still renders
cases.actual: A 3,000 character query was handled without an error.

cases.title: Open the counselor booking page
cases.expected: Available slots or an empty state render
cases.actual: Booking page rendered with the published slots or an empty state.

cases.title: Student opens the administration area
cases.expected: Access denied; the page is not served
cases.actual: Student is refused the administration area.

cases.title: Student opens the counselor risk queue
cases.expected: Access denied; no risk data is exposed
cases.actual: Student is refused the counselor risk queue.

cases.title: Request a URL that does not exist
cases.expected: Handled not-found response, no stack trace
cases.actual: Unknown route returned a handled response rather than a stack trace.

cases.title: Open the student privacy and monitoring area
cases.expected: Consent state and the transparency panel render
cases.actual: Student privacy and monitoring area rendered.

cases.title: Change the monitoring consent decision
cases.expected: Consent is updated and confirmed on screen
cases.actual: Monitoring consent was changed from the student's own privacy page.

cases.title: Sign out and re-request a private page
cases.expected: Session is cleared and the dashboard is no longer served
cases.actual: Session ended; private pages require signing in again.

cases.title: Repeated sign-in attempts from one address
cases.expected: The auth rate limiter refuses further attempts with 429
cases.actual: The sign-in endpoint began refusing with 429 after 4 attempts in the window.
